meta.title: Milesight UG65 手動安裝 Cloudflare Tunnel
meta.author: Louis FU
meta.reading_time: 約 25 分鐘（跟住做約 40 分鐘）
meta.subtitle: 唔需要 root 密碼、唔拆機、唔刷 firmware —— 由 admin 帳號一路做到開機自動連線

items.title: Cloudflare 開 tunnel
items.desc: 攞 token，加 Public Hostname 同 Access policy

items.title: API 登入 gateway
items.desc: AES 加密密碼換 session cookie

items.title: 開 Node-RED
items.desc: 一個 /cgi RPC，唔需要㩒界面

items.title: 上傳 flow 觸發安裝
items.desc: root 執行腳本：寫檔、起 procd、註冊 tunnel

upgrades.label: 圖 1 · 連線拓撲
upgrades.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 720 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="連線拓撲：電腦經 API 設定 UG65；UG65 主動向 Cloudflare 建立 outbound tunnel；外部瀏覽器經 Cloudflare 入返 gateway">
  <style>
    .hl { fill: currentColor; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 600; }
    .mono { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 14px; }
    .sm { fill: currentColor; font-size: 12.5px; opacity: .62; }
    .box { fill: var(--paper-2); stroke: var(--line); stroke-width: 1.2; }
    .chip { fill: var(--paper-2); stroke: var(--line); stroke-width: 1.2; }
    .wire { stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.6; fill: none; opacity: .62; }
    .wira { stroke: var(--accent); stroke-width: 2.2; fill: none; }
    .dasha { stroke: var(--accent); stroke-width: 1.8; fill: none; stroke-dasharray: 6 5; opacity: .9; }
    .acc { fill: var(--accent); }
    .num { fill: var(--accent); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }
  </style>
  <defs>
    <marker id="o-cur" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8.5" refY="5" markerWidth="5" markerHeight="5" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0 0 L10 5 L0 10 z" fill="currentColor"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="o-acc" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8.5" refY="5" markerWidth="5" markerHeight="5" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0 0 L10 5 L0 10 z" style="fill: var(--accent)"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- 你部電腦 -->
  <rect class="box" x="24" y="26" width="232" height="78" rx="3"/>
  <text class="hl" x="42" y="56">你部電腦</text>
  <text class="sm" x="42" y="78">curl · openssl · flows.json</text>
  <text class="sm" x="42" y="94">同 gateway 同網段</text>

  <!-- 瀏覽器 -->
  <rect class="box" x="448" y="26" width="248" height="78" rx="3"/>
  <text class="hl" x="466" y="56">任何地方嘅瀏覽器</text>
  <text class="mono acc" x="466" y="80">gw.example.com</text>

  <!-- Cloudflare Edge -->
  <rect class="box" x="448" y="150" width="248" height="104" rx="3"/>
  <text class="hl" x="466" y="180">Cloudflare Edge</text>
  <text class="mono" x="466" y="204">Tunnel</text>
  <text class="mono" x="466" y="224">Access policy</text>
  <text class="sm" x="466" y="244">HTTPS → localhost:443</text>

  <!-- UG65 -->
  <rect class="box" x="24" y="160" width="348" height="190" rx="3"/>
  <text class="hl" x="42" y="190">Milesight UG65</text>

  <rect class="chip" x="42" y="204" width="312" height="24" rx="2"/>
  <text class="mono" x="53" y="221">Web GUI /cgi</text>

  <rect class="chip" x="42" y="234" width="312" height="24" rx="2"/>
  <text class="mono" x="53" y="251">/cgi-bin/file-import</text>

  <rect x="42" y="264" width="312" height="34" rx="2" style="fill:none; stroke: var(--accent); stroke-width: 1.6"/>
  <text class="mono acc" x="53" y="286">Node-RED exec = root</text>

  <rect class="chip" x="42" y="308" width="312" height="24" rx="2"/>
  <text class="mono" x="53" y="325">cloudflared · procd S95</text>

  <!-- ① 電腦 → API -->
  <line class="wire" x1="140" y1="104" x2="140" y2="152" marker-end="url(#o-cur)"/>
  <text class="num" x="152" y="122">①</text>
  <text class="sm" x="152" y="140">API</text>

  <!-- ② gateway outbound -->
  <line class="wira" x1="372" y1="186" x2="440" y2="172" marker-end="url(#o-acc)"/>
  <text class="num" x="394" y="164">②</text>

  <!-- ④ 請求推落嚟 -->
  <line class="dasha" x1="440" y1="222" x2="380" y2="238" marker-end="url(#o-acc)"/>
  <text class="num" x="396" y="258">④</text>

  <!-- ③ 瀏覽器 → edge -->
  <line class="wire" x1="572" y1="104" x2="572" y2="142" marker-end="url(#o-cur)"/>
  <text class="num" x="584" y="122">③</text>

  <!-- 圖例 -->
  <text class="sm" x="24" y="374">② cloudflared 主動 outbound（4 條 quic）　③ HTTPS　④ 請求經同一條 tunnel 推落嚟</text>
  <text class="sm" x="24" y="392">因為係 outbound，所以 SIM 網絡、冇公網 IP、冇 port forwarding 都上得到。</text>
</svg>
upgrades.caption: gateway 自己走出去註冊，所以 SIM 網絡、冇公網 IP 都上得到；入嚟嘅請求行返同一條連線。

upgrades.label: 圖 2 · admin 到 root 嘅唯一路線
upgrades.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 720 360" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="提權路線：admin 帳號六條路都行唔通，只有 Node-RED exec node 以 root 執行">
  <style>
    .hl { fill: currentColor; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 600; }
    .mono { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 14px; }
    .sm { fill: currentColor; font-size: 12.5px; opacity: .62; }
    .box { fill: var(--paper-2); stroke: var(--line); stroke-width: 1.2; }
    .boxa { fill: none; stroke: var(--accent); stroke-width: 2; }
    .dead { fill: none; stroke: var(--line); stroke-width: 1.2; }
    .x { stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.4; opacity: .4; }
    .wira { stroke: var(--accent); stroke-width: 2.4; fill: none; }
    .acc { fill: var(--accent); }
  </style>
  <defs>
    <marker id="p-acc" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8.5" refY="5" markerWidth="5" markerHeight="5" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0 0 L10 5 L0 10 z" style="fill: var(--accent)"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- admin -->
  <rect class="box" x="24" y="72" width="212" height="34" rx="3"/>
  <text class="mono" x="38" y="95">admin · uid 6833</text>

  <!-- dead ends -->
  <g>
    <rect class="dead" x="24" y="124" width="212" height="28" rx="2"/>
    <text class="mono" x="38" y="143">su -</text>
    <line class="x" x1="30" y1="128" x2="230" y2="148"/>
    <line class="x" x1="230" y1="128" x2="30" y2="148"/>

    <rect class="dead" x="24" y="160" width="212" height="28" rx="2"/>
    <text class="mono" x="38" y="179">getty-bk setuid</text>
    <line class="x" x1="30" y1="164" x2="230" y2="184"/>
    <line class="x" x1="230" y1="164" x2="30" y2="184"/>

    <rect class="dead" x="24" y="196" width="212" height="28" rx="2"/>
    <text class="mono" x="38" y="215">busybox SUID</text>
    <line class="x" x1="30" y1="200" x2="230" y2="220"/>
    <line class="x" x1="230" y1="200" x2="30" y2="220"/>

    <rect class="dead" x="24" y="232" width="212" height="28" rx="2"/>
    <text class="mono" x="38" y="251">cron / rc.local</text>
    <line class="x" x1="30" y1="236" x2="230" y2="256"/>
    <line class="x" x1="230" y1="236" x2="30" y2="256"/>

    <rect class="dead" x="24" y="268" width="212" height="28" rx="2"/>
    <text class="mono" x="38" y="287">Docker / supervisord</text>
    <line class="x" x1="30" y1="272" x2="230" y2="292"/>
    <line class="x" x1="230" y1="272" x2="30" y2="292"/>

    <rect class="dead" x="24" y="304" width="212" height="28" rx="2"/>
    <text class="mono" x="38" y="323">爆 root hash</text>
    <line class="x" x1="30" y1="308" x2="230" y2="328"/>
    <line class="x" x1="230" y1="308" x2="30" y2="328"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 全部唔得 -->
  <text class="sm" x="24" y="352">六條路都實測失敗</text>

  <!-- Node-RED -->
  <line class="wire" x1="236" y1="89" x2="286" y2="89"/>
  <rect class="boxa" x="286" y="58" width="196" height="116" rx="3"/>
  <text class="hl" x="302" y="86">Node-RED</text>
  <text class="sm" x="302" y="106">由 procd 以 root 啟動</text>
  <text class="mono acc" x="302" y="132">exec node</text>
  <text class="sm" x="302" y="152">實測 id → uid=0</text>

  <!-- root -->
  <line class="wira" x1="482" y1="116" x2="534" y2="116" marker-end="url(#p-acc)"/>
  <rect class="box" x="534" y="94" width="162" height="44" rx="3"/>
  <text class="mono acc" x="550" y="122">uid = 0 (root)</text>

  <!-- actions -->
  <line class="wira" x1="615" y1="138" x2="615" y2="164" marker-end="url(#p-acc)"/>
  <rect class="box" x="482" y="170" width="214" height="28" rx="2"/>
  <text class="mono" x="496" y="189">寫 /etc/init.d/*</text>

  <rect class="box" x="482" y="204" width="214" height="28" rx="2"/>
  <text class="mono" x="496" y="223">binary + chmod 755</text>

  <rect class="box" x="482" y="238" width="214" height="28" rx="2"/>
  <text class="mono" x="496" y="257">procd enable / start</text>

  <rect x="482" y="272" width="214" height="28" rx="2" style="fill:none; stroke: var(--accent); stroke-width: 1.6"/>
  <text class="mono acc" x="496" y="291">清走臨時 root shell</text>

  <text class="sm" x="482" y="352">唯一「非官方」嘅一步只係用 API 代替手㩒界面</text>
</svg>
upgrades.caption: 六條常見提權路全部實測失敗；Node-RED 由 procd 以 root 啟動，所以 exec node 就係 root shell。

upgrades.title: 唔想用產生器？
upgrades.text: 可以唔用 make_flows.py，直接把附錄「完整安裝腳本」貼入 exec node 嘅 command，再自己砌 inject(once) → exec(oldrc:true) → debug 三個 node。效果完全一樣。

upgrades.title: 唔好即刻開 domain
upgrades.text: cloudflared 要 60–70 秒先完成註冊（排喺一堆 LoRaWAN 服務後面）。重開機後太早開，見到 502 係正常，唔係部署失敗。

<svg viewBox="0 0 720 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="開機時序：0 秒開機，START 19 至 96，71 秒通 443，107 秒通 22">

  <g>

    <line class="tick" x1="240" y1="176" x2="240" y2="146"/>
    <text class="mono" x="240" y="140" text-anchor="middle">82</text>

    <line class="tick" x1="312" y1="176" x2="312" y2="146"/>
    <text class="mono" x="312" y="140" text-anchor="middle">95</text>

    <line class="tick" x1="332" y1="176" x2="332" y2="146"/>
    <text class="mono" x="332" y="140" text-anchor="middle">96</text>

  <!-- milestones -->
  <line class="wira" x1="60" y1="176" x2="412" y2="176" marker-end="url(#t-acc)"/>

  <text class="mono acc" x="415" y="124" text-anchor="middle">71s</text>
  <text class="sm" x="415" y="108" text-anchor="middle">443 通</text>

  <line class="wira" x1="415" y1="176" x2="596" y2="176" marker-end="url(#t-acc)"/>
  <line class="tick" x1="595" y1="152" x2="595" y2="198"/>
  <text class="mono acc" x="595" y="124" text-anchor="middle">107s</text>
  <text class="sm" x="595" y="108" text-anchor="middle">22 通</text>

  <!-- 圖例 -->

  <text class="sm" x="60" y="248">60–70 秒之間 cloudflared 完成註冊；早過呢個時間開 domain 見到 502 係正常。</text>
